name: Runner Extras - Precompiled Dep Cache Null First
brief: Issue #4783, the first of two ordered bundles: asks about table 61600, which only the second bundle's precompiled dependency declares.
description: Issue #4783. Run before tests/runner-extras/xmlport-precompiled-dep-metadata, this bundle asks for table 61600 while no registered .app declares it, so the runner's table metadata cache records it as absent. The second bundle's dependency .app declares the table; registering it must drop that absence, or the second bundle's own use of the table fails with NavMetadataNotFoundException. Runner-specific: the corpus runs one app set per service tier and has no second bundle in the same process.
